vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: The gateway's shared cache uses the same SHA-256 key as the skills' local cache, so file names stay compatible.

conops.paraphrase: For each clip the gateway computes the cache key before deciding between a hit and a synthesis.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: One cache serves all users, so a clip one person bought is free to everyone else.

conops.paraphrase: A cache hit is recorded at zero cost, whichever person originally synthesized the clip.

vision.paraphrase: Goal G2 says a re-run of an unchanged spine makes no OpenRouter calls and adds nothing to the caller's spend.

conops.paraphrase: The user re-runs the spine with the same model, voice, style and texts.
The result reads that every clip was cached and that the call cost nothing.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: The cache is keyed on model, voice, style and text together, so any change to one of them produces a new clip.

conops.paraphrase: A clip whose inputs differ from every cached clip is a miss and is synthesized.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Each clip is cached as soon as it is made, so a retry after a failure pays only for clips still missing.

conops.paraphrase: A retry of the same request after a failure finds the finished clips cached and synthesizes only the rest.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: Download URLs are reusable for 15 minutes, so the client can fetch a clip more than once within that window.

conops.paraphrase: The client downloads each clip from its URL into the local cache.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: An expired download URL is refused, and the refusal tells the caller how to get a fresh link.

conops.paraphrase: A download of an expired URL is answered with a gone status that tells the caller to call the tool again.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: An expired URL is renewed by calling the tool again, which is a free cache hit.

conops.paraphrase: The repeat call after an expired link is all cache hits and costs nothing.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: Download URLs are unguessable per-clip tokens, so the URL reveals nothing about the cache key or other callers' clips.

conops.paraphrase: The URL the client downloads from is the only handle it gets, and it cannot be derived from the clip's cache key.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: The cache has a size cap, and the least-recently-used clips are evicted when it is exceeded.

conops.paraphrase: The cache row of the functional summary requires least-recently-used eviction at the configured size cap.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: shared audio cache
vision.paraphrase: A cache hit refreshes the clip's last-used time, so clips in active use are not evicted first.

conops.paraphrase: Every cache hit has its last-used time refreshed as it is recorded.
